action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.864) with weak seasonality (0.114) and non-stationary structure. In this regime, a robust barycenter (dba) that respects the geometric structure of the forecast ensemble without chasing window-specific noise is the right combination. The leader's margin over the runner-up is 0.002 with an 'indistinguishable' verdict, confirming that no alternative strategy in the history offers a statistically meaningful improvement.
